name: E195-E2 era livery
description: White fuselage with thin navy pinstripes along the lower side from the nose, sweeping down and back under the tail; 'porter' in navy lower case over the forward windows and again under the belly; the fin navy, patterned with the word 'porter' repeated diagonally in lighter blue; white engines with navy pinstripes.

sources.note: C-GKQJ (E195-E2) left side from below, 2025-02-23: title, belly title, pinstripes, fin.

sources.title: C-GKXR Embraer E195-E2 (ERJ 190-400 STD) Porter Halifax YHZ 17.6.25 (CC BY-SA 4.0, Colin Cooke Photo)
sources.note: C-GKXR taking off at Halifax, left side, 2025-06-26 (dated 2025-06-17 in its title). Fitted to shapes/E295.json (within 25 px; the fin's trailing edge reads about 15 px off, so the rows' ends are approximate): the fin's rows of 'porter', their angle (about 33° down toward the trailing edge, on the fin as built), spacing (about 0.67 m from one white row to the next, light-blue rows between) and phase, and the colours.

pattern.name: the fin's light-blue rows of the wordmark

areas.name: navy field under the repeated wordmark (the whole fin, so the pattern spans it)

logos.description: The fin covered in the lower-case 'porter' wordmark repeated in rows that rise toward the trailing edge at about 33° (on both sides, the words reading normally), alternate rows white and light blue on navy, about 0.67 m from one white row to the next.
A small Canadian flag after the registration on the rear fuselage.

titles.style: Porter's wordmark: rounded, medium-weight geometric lower case in navy over the forward windows.
The wordmark again under the belly ahead of the wing, read from below.

notes: Drawn from E195-E2s (C-GKQJ Feb 2025 from below, C-GKON June 2026). Porter's Dash 8-400s weren't checked and may wear the earlier scheme. The pinstripes' exact paths are approximate. Re-checked 2026-11-15 on C-GKON (right side, near level) and C-GKQJ: the title sits well under the windows, about 2.8 m aft of the forward door's middle (x 0.143 to 0.22), its t's top about 0.5 m under the window line and its baseline about 1.25 m under it (y -0.33, height 0.33: it had been drawn twice that size, reaching the windows); lowercase 0.77 of the t. The belly title's length (0.14) is read off C-GKQJ from below (low). The pinstripes curve down toward the tail: smooth. Fin redrawn 2026-11-22 (the maintainer's sighting C-GZQW showed the pattern the plain navy fin lacked): measured on C-GKXR (2025), the rows of 'porter' are drawn as stripes, alternately white and light blue, each 0.13 m wide (the letters' x-height is about 0.23 m; their strokes cover less), at the photo's angle, spacing and phase. Each row is lettering, not a line: the stripe is a simplification for drawing at a distance.
history: Replaces Skyarium v1's approximate standard (a few colors from memory).
